quote.text: Outbound is the only channel you fully control. When the ads stall and the inbox is quiet, that's your edge.
quote.author: Alex Hormozi

schedule: No prospect replies and no money or security flags in the inbox over the last 48 hours, so this is a pure execution day. The blocker to clear first: the last Facebook Ads pull still shows the Lead Gen campaign as PAUSED at a $35/day budget. Confirm it's actually delivering before anything else, then spend the day on personal follow-up to the 27+ unbooked GHL leads and manual outbound. Don't buy new leads while old ones sit uncontacted.
focus: Last ads pull still shows the Lead Gen campaign as PAUSED at $35/day. Open Ads Manager and confirm it's actually delivering before the 8 AM refresh — if it's off, your only paid lead source is dead and the funnel runs dry today.

27+ leads at ~$17 CPL and still zero closed means the problem is follow-up, not lead flow. Run a personal call-and-text pass on every unbooked GHL lead today with a direct booking link, starting with anyone who opted in this week.

Inbox is clear of prospects, so today is an outbound day. Confirm the 9 AM auto-post hit all 16 FB groups, then manually DM 10 home-service businesses to build pipeline that doesn't depend on ad spend.

Heads up: A2P campaign is still in carrier review, so GHL workflows can't text leads yet. If it clears today, link the 413 number and flip the three workflows live so new leads get auto-texted instead of waiting on you.

Everything else is noise: an Anthropic API rate-limit notice (no action), a NYT crossword email, a LinkedIn post update, and a ClearViewMA telehealth forms reminder (personal, not Novaro). No prospect email action needed; today's work is verifying ad delivery, lead follow-up, and outbound.
